title: The Week Ahead: FOMC meeting begins (October 27-28); FOMC meeting concludes; Bitcoin difficulty adjustment, estimated +5.37%, 584 blocks to go
dek: What is on the calendar for the week of October 26: scheduled events only, no predictions.
body: This is the week's known calendar: scheduled dates only, published in advance by the institutions involved. What happens at them is the week's news; this story only tells you when to watch.
Thursday, October 29: Bitcoin difficulty adjustment, estimated +5.37%, 584 blocks to go.
Thursday, October 29: PCE: Personal Income and Outlays.
Thursday, October 29: GDP: Gross Domestic Product.
Friday, October 30: Deribit Bitcoin monthly options expiry, open interest 136,030 BTC.
Friday, October 30: Deribit Ether monthly options expiry, open interest 324,788 ETH.
